name: luma-ui
description: Machine-readable component manifest for the Luma Design System. Each entry packages a component's variants, sizes, states, token bindings, rules, and example usage so an AI tool can build on-brand UI without parsing source files. JSON is used (not Markdown) because it is ~80% more token-efficient for this payload and removes ambiguity for agents.
note: This is the specification layer. Component source (React/TypeScript), Storybook examples, and the Figma library live in a separate private implementation repo. The `import` field on each component reflects the intended package API, not code shipped in this repo. Treat this manifest as authoritative for component shape, tokens, and rules — not as an installable registry.
author: Muhammad Imran (https://imran.fi)

components.name: Button
components.description: Primary interactive control. Emphasis is a ladder, not a palette — one primary per surface.
rules: Filled variants (default, secondary, destructive, success, warning, info): NO shadow — the solid color is the affordance.
Outline gets shadow.xs; ghost and link are intentionally flat.
Warning uses color.on-warning (#111111, dark text) — amber + white fails WCAG AA.
Icon-only buttons require an aria-label.
All button icons are 20px at 2px stroke regardless of the size prop.
destructive is for irreversible actions only; always confirm via Dialog.

components.name: IconButton
components.description: Square, icon-only action. Same heights as Button.
rules: Always requires aria-label.
Icon is 20px at 2px stroke.

components.name: Input
components.description: Single-line text field. 36px height to match Button.
rules: Always pair with a visible Label — placeholder is a hint, never the only label.
Error state uses the color.error ring (not color.destructive).
Never change border-width on error — use a ring to avoid layout shift.

components.name: Textarea
components.description: Multi-line text field. Mirrors Input states.
rules: Min-height 72px (three lines of body-sm).
Resize vertical only — horizontal resize breaks layouts.

components.name: Label
components.description: Form field label. body-sm-strong.

components.name: Checkbox
components.description: Binary choice submitted with a form, or multiple independent choices in a group.
rules: 4px radius (not pill).
Checked uses color.primary; disabled at 50% opacity.

components.name: RadioGroup
components.description: Choose one of 2–5 options where seeing all at once aids the decision.
rules: 16×16px, pill radius.
Checked uses color.primary.

components.name: Select
components.description: Compact single-choice for up to 6 options.
rules: Trigger height matches Input (36px).
Menu uses shadow.md — above page, below Dialog.
Use for ≤6 options; use Combobox for ≥7.

components.name: Combobox
components.description: Searchable single-choice for 7+ options, or when users know what they're typing.
rules: Adds a search input above the option list.
Prefer Select for ≤6 options.

components.name: Switch
components.description: Binary setting that applies instantly, no Save button.
rules: 36×20px track, 16×16px thumb.
Off uses color.surface-active (neutral grey), not red — red implies error.

components.name: Slider
components.description: Pick a value along a range.
rules: Track is 6px, surface-2, pill.
Thumb is a 16px canvas circle with hairline-strong border + shadow.sm — the one filled control that gets a shadow.

components.name: Toggle
components.description: Two-state pressed/unpressed control.
rules: In a ToggleGroup segmented control, items sit flush (itemSpacing 0).

components.name: Form
components.description: Composition wrapper — label, helper text, and error message slots. Built on react-hook-form + Zod.
components.import: import { Form, FormField, FormLabel, FormHelper, FormErrorMessage } from '@n1imran/luma-ui'
rules: Helper text uses caption + ink-muted.
Error message uses error-text, replaces helper on validation failure.

components.name: Dialog
components.description: Blocking decision or confirmation the user must answer. Built on Radix.
rules: Use for confirmations — never a Toast.
Use Sheet for long forms.
Radix handles focus trap, escape, ARIA.

components.name: Sheet
components.description: Complex editing or detail view that keeps page context.
rules: 400px wide from left or right.
Use for editing flows needing more room than a Dialog; never for confirmations.

components.name: Popover
components.description: Small contextual content anchored to a trigger, opens on click, can contain interactive controls.
rules: 320px max.
Opens on click; for read-only hover content use HoverCard.

components.name: HoverCard
components.description: Read-only preview shown on hover (300ms delay).
rules: Same recipe as Popover.
Never put a button or interactive control inside a HoverCard.

components.name: DropdownMenu
components.description: A list of actions on an element.
rules: Use for action lists — never a Popover with hand-rolled buttons.
Destructive items use destructive text + tinted hover.

components.name: Tooltip
components.description: Label or hint on hover, no interaction inside.
rules: Never place interactive content in a Tooltip.
Highest z-index (600) — always topmost.

components.name: Command
components.description: Command palette — searchable action list. Highest-elevation surface.
rules: 560px max, input row 44px (taller than standard Input).
Active items use primary-subtle bg + primary text.
Always show a Kbd hint for the opening shortcut.

components.name: Tabs
components.description: Segmented switch between sibling views. Pill-tabs pattern.
rules: List has subtle surface-2 bg + 4px inner padding.
Active trigger gets canvas bg + shadow.xs.
Items sit flush (itemSpacing 0) — avoid underline tabs for product UI.

components.name: Accordion
components.description: Collapsible stacked sections.
rules: Triggers are <button> elements (Radix).
Open state tints the trigger to color.primary.
Content collapses top padding to zero.

components.name: Breadcrumb
components.description: Hierarchical path navigation.
rules: Current item uses ink (not ink-muted) and aria-current.

components.name: Pagination
components.description: Page-by-page navigation through a list.
rules: Active page uses primary-subtle bg + primary text.

components.name: NavItem
components.description: Sidebar / nav list item.
rules: Active item uses primary-subtle bg + primary text.
Sidebar nav icons are 16px.

components.name: Badge
components.description: Count or category on an item in lists and tables.
rules: Badge icons are 12px.
Use status variants only for status — not decoration.

components.name: Avatar
components.description: User or entity image with initials fallback.
rules: Always pill radius.
Fallback uses primary-subtle bg + primary text.
2px solid canvas border separates avatars in groups.

components.name: Card
components.description: Content container. Never nest cards.
rules: rounded-xl (12px), border, canvas bg.
Elevated adds shadow.sm.
Descriptions use ink-muted.

components.name: Alert
components.description: Persistent, status-colored condition of a page or section.
rules: Use the status color's bg/border/text triple — never mix tokens across status groups.
Icon uses the solid status color (e.g. color.success, not color.success-text).
components.example: <Alert variant="warning" title="Heads up">Your trial ends soon.</Alert>

components.name: Progress
components.description: Determinate long-running operation.
rules: Track is surface-2, fill defaults to primary.
Status variants use their solid colors, not the bg/border/text tokens.

components.name: Skeleton
components.description: Passive loading placeholder for page or section content.
rules: Use for passive page loads; use Spinner for active waiting after an action.

components.name: Separator
components.description: 1px divider between sections.
rules: Full width or height.
Don't stack against a bordered element (double line).

components.name: Table
components.description: Tabular data.
rules: Column headers use the eyebrow (uppercase) type role.
Selected rows use primary-subtle.

components.name: Panel
components.description: Flat bordered region for grouping content without elevation.

components.name: Chip
components.description: Removable filter or input value.
rules: Includes a remove affordance (×).
Use for active filters and multi-value inputs.

components.name: Toast
components.description: Transient result of an action just performed. Use Sonner for stacking/dismiss.
rules: Max-width 360px.
Always above Dialog (z 500 > 400).
Use Sonner not a custom Toast for most cases.
Never use a Toast for confirmations.

components.name: Spinner
components.description: Active waiting after a user action (submit, fetch in flight).
rules: For passive page loads use Skeleton instead.

components.name: StatusDot
components.description: Live presence or system state, always paired with a label.
rules: Never appears without a text label in the same flex row.
pulse is reserved for genuinely live states (deploying, recording, online).

components.name: EmptyState
components.description: Placeholder when there is nothing to display yet.
rules: Icon at 48px on a surface-2 rounded background.
Title in body-sm-strong, description in body-sm tone muted.
Composable: Icon → Title → Description → Actions.

components.name: Note
components.description: Persistent inline tip or guidance, quieter than Alert.
rules: Neutral surface (surface-1 + hairline), never status-tinted backgrounds — that's Alert's job.
Only the optional icon takes a status color.
components.example: <Note variant="tip" icon title="Pro tip">Press <Kbd>⌘K</Kbd> to open the palette.</Note>

components.name: CodeBlock
components.description: Display a block code sample with optional header + copy.
rules: surface-1 bg with hairline border and copy button.
Always mono.

components.name: InlineCode
components.description: Inline code span.
rules: surface-2 bg with sm radius.
Always mono. Never style backticks-as-text.

components.name: Kbd
components.description: Render a keyboard shortcut. Chords use KbdGroup.
rules: Mono 13px on surface-1 with a 2px bottom border for key-cap depth.
Chords render as separate Kbds.

components.name: Link
components.description: Inline text navigation.

components.name: Text
components.description: Typography primitive binding text to the 10 semantic roles. Reach for this before raw text classes.

components.name: Container
components.description: Page-width centred wrapper.

components.name: Stack
components.description: Vertical layout (forms, lists, panels).

components.name: Inline
components.description: Horizontal layout (button rows, toolbars, chip lists).

components.name: Grid
components.description: CSS Grid (cards, dashboards).

components.name: Icon
components.description: Lucide icon wrapper. 1,500+ icons, stroke scales with size.
rules: Under 20px → 1px stroke; 20px and up → 2px stroke.
Inherits color from parent currentColor — never set icon color directly.

components.name: ScrollArea
components.description: Styled scroll container with custom scrollbars.

components.name: Collapsible
components.description: Show/hide a single region of content.
